item.title: Bulletin updated at 23:20 HKT 15/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of Guangdong on Saturday morning. Temperatures will fall appreciably and there will be a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of the associated winter monsoon, it will be cold in the morning over Guangdong early next week. A dry replenishment of the monsoon is expected to bring persistently cold and generally fine weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 16/12 (Saturday)
Wind: Light winds force 2. Becoming north force 5, force 6 offshore, occasionally up to force 8 on high ground.
Weather: Temperatures will fall appreciably. Mainly cloudy. A few rain patches and relatively low visibility in the morning. Cold at night.
Temp range: 12 - 24 C
R.H. range: 60 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
